description: List the subscription plans on offer, to quote prices or to get the `price_id` that create_checkout (workspace without a subscription) and change_plan (existing subscription) take. Each plan has its monthly photo allowance (`credits`), billing interval and price: `unit_amount` is in the smallest unit of `currency` (USD), and `currency_options` lists the fixed local prices whose keys create_checkout accepts as `currency`. Read-only and free; takes no parameters and is the same for every caller. It does not show the workspace's own balance: use get_credits for that.
name: list_plans
title: List subscription plans
